title: New Kernel Stabilized System
statement: theorem coherentFormalModule_kernel_stabilized_system {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData) (F H : CoherentFormalModule X I) (α : F ⟶ H) (c : ℕ) (hc : ∀ (l m : ℕ) (h : m + c ≤ l), Subobject.mk (Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op l)) ≫ F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_right m c) h)).op)) = Subobject.mk (Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫ F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op))) : ∃ (S : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ X.Modules) (j : S ⟶ F.obj), ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ e : S.obj (op m) ≅ Abelian.image (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫ F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op), e.hom ≫ Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫ F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op) = j.app (op m)

proof.text: For each n take the image of a_n : ker(alpha_(n+c)) -> F_n. Naturality of alpha induces kernel maps along shifted transition maps. Functoriality of F makes these commute with a_n. Use Mathlib image.map and image.map_homMk'_ι to obtain transition maps between the images. Cancel the monic image inclusions to prove identities and composition, and take the inclusions as a natural transformation. Finally use the inverse of Abelian.imageIsoImage to identify each term with the stated abelian image, with compatibility from imageIsoImage_hom_comp_image_ι. This construction works for every c, without the stabilization hypothesis.

proof_origin.place: Direct categorical construction by the second reader: kernel.map, image.map, image.map_homMk'_ι, Abelian.imageIsoImage; realizes the system in Stacks 087X.
